These graphs show concentrations of carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide in the atmosphere. Historical observations are from 1950 through 2023, with each black line representing a different data source. Projections extend from 2005 to 2100. These projected concentrations were among the inputs that fed into all of the global climate models whose results are reported in the project team’s other observation/projection pairings. Therefore, these graphs show no hindcast and no multi-model average or spread, as projected greenhouse gas concentrations were a common input rather than a model output.
